hooks.prompt: A task was just created. Read the task description ($ARGUMENTS) and decide whether it involves software implementation, code changes, debugging, refactoring, or other development work. Respond with JSON containing 'isCodeTask' (boolean) and 'suggestion' (string). If it is not code work, set isCodeTask to false and suggestion to an empty string. If it is code work, set isCodeTask to true and set suggestion to: 'Use ai-plan progressive disclosure for planning context — this must be enforced by `design-spec`, `write-plan`, and `execute-plan`, not treated as optional advice. Open docs/agent-plan/context/index.md and read the minimum in-scope module set under docs/agent-plan/context/modules/ that matches this task before planning (L1) — usually one module file; add a directly-coupled module only when the task crosses that module boundary. Consult docs/agent-plan/context/module-map.json only for task ordering, and docs/agent-plan/context/code-map.json only after the plan names specific symbols. Never inject all module files or the full code map. Plans must carry a Planning module header and Planning context section, or execute-plan must stop before implementation.'
